basic_info.description:
HOME FEATURES:
*Spacious 3bed/2ba home + 3 parking spaces (tandem)
* Formal living room + dining room 
*Remodeled kitchen with new 36" stove, dishwasher, range hood
*Washer/dryer onsite
*Newly painted
*Beautiful wood floors throughout 
*Decorative fireplace and built in wood cabinets
*Master bathroom with en-suite bathroom+ office den allowing you to work from home
*2 additional bedrooms with ample closets
*Washer/dryer hookups
*Central furnace 
*Large backyard for outdoor enjoyment
*3 parking spaces in driveway

LOCATION:
*In desirable West wood park near Ocean Ocean, Stonestown Galleria, SFSU
*Near public transportation, freeway entrance to 280 leading to Peninsula and South Bay
*Great location near parks, retail stores, restaurants on Ocean Avenue, West Portal

1 year lease. Tenant pays for utilities.
